title: Emergent vs Lovable: Which AI App Builder Is Better in 2026?
summary: Emergent and Lovable are both AI app builders targeting different use cases. Here's an honest breakdown of which is better for your project — and when Blink is the stronger choice.
body_markdown: The main alternatives: Blink (full-stack, DB included), Bolt.new (strong code generation), v0 (UI component generation), Base44 (internal tools). Both Lovable and Emergent leave you needing database, auth, and hosting — Blink provides all three included. See our[Lovable alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/lovable-alternatives) and[Emergent alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/emergent-alternatives) guides.
